injects.title: Meteorological Alert Issued
injects.description: National Meteorological Department issues a high-risk alert for heavy precipitation in KP, Western Punjab, and Sindh due to La Niña and Western Disturbance convergence.

injects.title: River Levels Critical in Indus Catchment
injects.description: Water levels in the Indus River and Kabul River catchments are rising rapidly, exceeding critical thresholds in Kashmore and Sukkur districts.

injects.title: Mass Evacuation Orders
injects.description: Emergency evacuation orders issued for 2.2 million people in the exposure zone. Roads in Rajanpur and Dera Ghazi Khan are becoming impassable due to hill torrents.
